thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: elevated 5xx rate detected in eu-central gateway — alert threshold breached (p50 latency + 5xx spike) :rotating_light:

sara_ng: saw it, dashboards show 502 + gateway timeouts from eu-central edge to origin pool A. spike started ~2m ago.

mike_hsu: confirmed, upstream logs show `502 Bad Gateway` from origin-proxy-03. error rate ~18% over 1m. any recent deploys?

deepa_p: no user-facing deploys in eu-central in last 30m. infra autoscaler scaled down origin-proxy-03 earlier, maybe unhealthy.

incident-bot: PAGED: @oncall-bot -> oncall runbook eu-central-network-failures. severity: SEV2.

oncall-bot: paging oncall -> @ryan_ops (primary). please ack and run initial checks.

ryan_ops: ack. looking at healthchecks now. `curl` to origin-proxy-03 returns 502 intermittently. conn-reset / downstream TLS errors in logs.

mike_hsu: can we shift traffic away from eu-central to eu-west as temporary? routing supports weighted shift per region, 10% increments.

sara_ng: suggest graceful fallback: start with 20% to eu-west then 50% if errors persist. lower risk than full cutover. communicate to customers if latency changes.

deepa_p: before shift we should disable prefix caching on eu-central to avoid stale KV cache causing downstream errors. also check memcached eviction rates.

ryan_ops: running playbook step 3: `check origin-proxy health, restart if necessary` — restarting origin-proxy-03 now. rolling restart of pool will take ~90s.

deploy-bot: rollout: origin-proxy-03 restart initiated by ryan_ops; job id ab12cd.

mike_hsu: while restart happens, let's open throttle on long requests and enable circuit-breaker at gateway layer for eu-central to prevent cascading. I'll apply `gateway/circuit-breaker: tripping=10%` for 60s.

ryan_ops: circuit-breaker applied. setting route weight: eu-central -> 80%, eu-west -> 20%. executing `routectl set-weight eu-central=80 eu-west=20`.

incident-bot: NOTE: autopreview will surface cold-cache latency in eu-west. expect some p99 increases for a short window.

eva_support: customer-impact: initial sampling shows a handful of active sessions impacted (<0.2% of active keys). queued support tickets from eu-central region — flagging top 3 customers for outreach.

mike_hsu: origin-proxy-03 restart completed but health checks are still flaky. logs show `TLS handshake timeout` on some connections to downstream storage. that smells like network flakiness.

deepa_p: can ops infra run BGP/peering probe against that AZ? I'll open a ticket with network team.

ryan_ops: running `mtr` and `tcpdump` now, uploading pcap to thread gist: https://internal.gists/reports/1723456789-pcap (placeholder)

mike_hsu: errors subsided after route weight change — 5xx dropped to ~2% in last 2m. nice. keep monitoring.

incident-bot: METRIC UPDATE: 5xx rate eu-central: 2.1% -> down from 18% after 18m. latency p50 stable, p99 elevated by ~40ms.

ryan_ops: plan: keep eu-west at 20% for 30m, continue investigation with network team for origin-proxy->storage TLS handshakes. if 5xx drops under 1% keep rolling down fallback.

sara_ng: agree. also create a short-term alert to notify if 5xx goes >5% again during rollback window.

eva_support: sending proactive note to impacted accounts: brief incident summary + ETA for resolution. will include mitigation (traffic fallback) and expected minimal request retries.

mike_hsu: network team responded — intermittent packet loss observed on transit to storage cluster in eu-central-az2. they've raised an internal incident.

deepa_p: given that, let's keep eu-west at 20% for 60m and schedule full traffic shift if packet loss not resolved in 45m. also add a deployment freeze in eu-central until network is clean.

ryan_ops: will coordinate with network and SRE. handing off on-call to @sara_ng in 30m — she'll have summary + links to traces/pcap.

oncall-bot: handoff scheduled: from ryan_ops -> sara_ng at +30m. please update channel once accepted.

incident-bot: ACTIONS CREATED: #INC-1723456789 - cross-region fallback initiated; owners: ryan_ops, sara_ng, mike_hsu. playbook link: https://runbooks/internal/cross-region-fallback

sara_ng: ack handoff in advance. I'll keep the weighted route and retry policy as-is and escalate to product if any customer-visible latency persists past 2h.

eva_support: I'll post a postmortem stub in #postmortems and collect customer impact details after incident is resolved.

mike_hsu: one more check — confirm model-serving variants pinned to same version across regions? we don't want A/B mismatch during routing.

deepa_p: confirmed model hash `sha256:7f3a...` is identical in eu-west and eu-central for serving pool. no risk.

ryan_ops: leaving final note: immediate mitigations = restart origin-proxy, circuit-breaker, route weight shift (20% eu-west). root cause likely transit packet loss to storage in eu-central-az2. continuing investigation. handing off to sara_ng.

sara_ng: took over. will maintain comms, escalate network incident and update once network team provides ETA. thanks all — :thumbsup:
